title: Sir Gawain, Lines 160–183
subtitle: Description of knight and horse — all green.
objectives: Read and translate authentic Middle English texts.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body: Al grene, with grene stele and grene enamayl... Reading the color symbolism and the French/English lexical mix. The green man, green horse, green armor. What does green mean? Supernatural, otherworldly, or natural/fertile? The poem never tells.

items.prompt: What is the focus of this lesson?
Can you apply this to reading?
items.answer: Work through examples with your notes.

lesson_completion.criteria: Mark complete when you understand Sir Gawain, Lines 160–183.
